# Larchmoor Heating - rate card

The card carries a weekday column and a weekend column; the office picks the column
that matches the visit before a job is quoted. One row for each item charged.

turns.prompt: Larchmoor Heating is reissuing its rates to the letting agents. What is the call-out fee?
The weekend rate. Give the number alone, as digits, with no label. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
